body: Part of e553ce, after 6f8xxx-wire step (see meta). skywaved: a screen runner on its own thread beside the shell runner, following the event log; the backend trait from dc27f7 with an adb implementation: adb devices, exec-out screencap -p (scaled and re-encoded to JPEG on the server), shell input tap/swipe/text/keyevent, install -r, am start / force-stop. Works with an emulator or a real phone over USB or adb over TCP, so it can be tested on the Pi with a physical device even where the emulator does not run (Google ships no linux-aarch64 emulator). Tests: a fake adb script like fake-claude.sh with recorded screencap fixtures; no real device in the test suite.
title: screen 3: server screen runner with the Android (adb) backend
